messages:
eva: Quick checkin on continuous-batcher split strategy. Ran a short experiment with an adaptive soft-reserve + token gate. Results mixed.
sam: Summarize the mixed bits?
eva: Split reduced per-shard P99 spikes but introduced routing churn that briefly elevated neighbours' queue depth. Token gate helped avoid splitting on tiny short requests.
liam: What were the exact signals?
eva: queue_depth > 110 for 7s AND median_latency > 65ms for 8s, and token_cost_estimate > 150. Soft-reserve = 15ms-equivalent with adaptive decay tied to kv_warmup_ms (min 400ms, max 2500ms).
anya: Did you try asymmetric hysteresis?
eva: Yes: split_cooldown 25s, merge_cooldown 150s. Reduced thrash.
sam: Any telemetry gaps we should fill before prod?
eva: Need routing_delta_rate, post_split_warmup_histogram per-tenant, and split_backpressure_spike counter.
liam: Rollout plan?
eva: 6h canary in two low-traffic clusters, auto rollback if P99 rises >10% or routing_delta_rate > threshold.
anya: Ping SRE once the canary starts.
sre-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-control-plane-9 at 2025-07-20T08:00Z. Will report status. :robot_face:
